title: OPERATING SYSTEMS II
description: Examines principles of computer operating systems: concurrent processes, memory management, job scheduling, multiprocessing, file systems, performance evaluation, and networking.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (CS 344 or 374) and (CS 271, ECE 375 or 370).
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 344, CS 374, CS 271, ECE 375 and ECE 370.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Elect & Computer Engineering (039) or Computer Science (307).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:20pm in DEAR 118 - Dearborn Hall 118 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
